fragments.text:
Currency conversion guide
## How a conversion is priced
A conversion quote has these components, in order: the mid-market rate for the
currency pair; the tier spread (a percentage of the gross converted amount);
the free monthly conversion allowance. If the whole conversion fits within the
customer's remaining monthly allowance, no spread is charged. Once the
allowance is exhausted, the full tier spread applies to the conversion.

Verta tariff schedule
## FX spreads by tier
The spread is applied over the mid-market rate only after the free monthly
conversion allowance is exhausted.

| Tier | FX spread | Free monthly conversion allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 | 1.5% | EUR 500 |
| Tier 2 | 0.9% | EUR 1,000 |
| Tier 3 | 0.5% | EUR 5,000 |

Currency conversion operations
## Allowance accounting
The free monthly conversion allowance is counted in EUR equivalent and resets on
the first calendar day of each month. Allowance consumption is recorded at
settlement. A conversion that would cross the allowance boundary has the tier
spread applied to the entire conversion, not only to the portion above the
boundary.

Onboarding and tiers
## Tier benefits
A higher tier lowers the FX spread, raises the free monthly conversion
allowance and raises both transfer limits.

fragments.text:
Payment dispute rules
## Eligibility conditions
A dispute is eligible only if all of the following hold: the reason code is
valid; the transaction status is settled; the transaction date is within the
reason code's window relative to the current date; and no customer-level
restriction applies (for example, an account under compliance review cannot
open new disputes until the review concludes).

Dispute handling process
## Raising a dispute
A dispute is raised against a single settled transaction. The customer supplies
the transaction reference and a reason code. The agent verifies eligibility
before the case is opened; an ineligible request is refused with the failing
condition named, except where confidentiality rules apply.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Glossary
## Settled transaction
A transaction the merchant has claimed and Verta has debited. Only settled
transactions can be disputed.

Payment dispute rules
## Escalation on blocked disputes
When a dispute is blocked by a customer-level restriction, the case must be
escalated to a human agent.

Escalation policy
## Mandatory escalation triggers
The agent must escalate to a human agent when: suspected fraud is reported on a
settled transaction above EUR 10,000; the customer explicitly asks for a human;
the request needs an action the agent has no tool for; a dispute is blocked by a
customer-level restriction; the customer disputes a figure the agent quoted.

Dispute handling process
## Raising a dispute
A dispute is raised against a single settled transaction. The customer supplies
the transaction reference and a reason code. The agent verifies eligibility
before the case is opened; an ineligible request is refused with the failing
condition named, except where confidentiality rules apply.

Glossary
## Provisional credit
A temporary refund applied while a dispute is reviewed; reversed if the dispute
is declined.

Transfer limits
## How the remainder is computed
The daily remainder equals the daily limit minus settled outgoing transfers
dated today. The monthly remainder equals the monthly limit minus settled
outgoing transfers in the current calendar month. A transfer is refused when
it exceeds either remainder.

Limit operations
## Limit refusal
A transfer that exceeds either the daily or the monthly remainder is refused in
full; it is never partially executed. The refusal names which remainder was
exceeded.

Transfer limits
## Daily and monthly limits by tier
Outgoing transfer limits are tracked in EUR equivalent, separately per day and
per calendar month. The daily and the monthly remainder are different numbers:
both are computed from the same settled-transactions source, but over
different windows.

| Tier | Daily limit | Monthly limit |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 | EUR 5,000 | EUR 50,000 |
| Tier 2 | EUR 20,000 | EUR 200,000 |
| Tier 3 | EUR 100,000 | EUR 1,000,000 |

Fee details
## Fees and limits
Fees charged by Verta do not count towards the transfer limits of the customer.
